title: What Happens When a Bullet Ant Stings You?
sources: Schmidt Pain Index, Paraponera clavata sting analysis
Journal of Neurophysiology, Poneratoxin synaptic blocking

lines.text: The bullet ant delivers the most agonizing sting known to humankind.
Victims describe the pain as identical to being shot by a high caliber gun.
lines.caps: Feels identical | to being *shot | by a *gun

lines.text: Its stinger pumps a paralyzing peptide neurotoxin called poneratoxin straight into your tissue.
The venom permanently blocks voltage-gated sodium channels in your sensory nerves.
This causes your brain to receive maximum agony signals non-stop for twenty-four straight hours.
Your limbs tremble uncontrollably and cold sweats drench your body.
Fortunately, the venom rarely kills, but the pain will feel unforgettable.
